summary: Iteration 2 backend regression + new endpoints. 36/36 pytest cases pass. Verified: POST /api/johndrop/import (gating, 8 created, idempotent skip=8, apply_seo=true SEO rules, apply_seo=false raw preserved, 401 unauthenticated), POST /api/pricing/calculate (formula 73.39/14.68/13.21, zero-cost 9.68, packaging+campaigns defaults, negative-value 422, 401 unauthenticated), legacy /api/products/seed still apply_seo=False with 8 raw products + idempotent. Two iteration-1 sync tests had to be rewritten because SEED_PRODUCTS was expanded with longer raw titles (>60 chars) and JD002 stock changed from 0 to 12 - tests now use explicit fixtures instead of relying on seed data shape.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1072 lines - approaching the 700-line guideline; split into routers/modules (auth, products, integrations, ai, pricing) for maintainability.
/api/products/seed is auth-protected but has no JohnDrop-connection guard like /api/johndrop/import - intentional legacy behavior, but documenting for clarity.

apply_seo_format uses re.escape(brand) but applies case-insensitive replacement; fine, but consider word-boundary regex to avoid removing brand substrings if brand happens to be a common word fragment.
Pricing constants (COMMISSION_PCT, FIXED_FEE, MIN_MARGIN_PCT) are module-level magic; consider exposing via GET /api/pricing/config so frontend doesn't duplicate them.
PricingIn allows cost=0 but no upper bound; harmless but a sanity ceiling (e.g. 1e7) would prevent runaway calculator inputs.
test_credentials: Auto-generated test+<uuid>@blingdrop.com / Test1234! per test module
seed_data_creation: Each test module creates an isolated user via /api/auth/register (3 distinct users to avoid cross-test interference between seed/import flows).
